summary: Frontend-only testing of the new live-SAP STO write feature on /inventory/inter-plant-transfer (auth via vms_session cookie, super_admin). Verified: (1) 2x-safety confirm dialog opens on 'Review & Create' with correct summary (ship-from P8 -> ship-to P1, location, date, 1-row items table) and NOTHING submitted at that point (progress bar not rendered); (2) 'Cancel, go back' closes the dialog with all form values intact (item row, qty=1, ship-from P8, ship-to P1, RAW MATERIAL GODOWN-P1, date 2026-08-25); (3) SUCCESS live path P27175 P8->P1: progress bar rendered with real step transitions validate(active)->validate(done)/check(active)->check(done)/create(active)->all done in ~8s, green banner 'Created in SAP as 00000000000000000000000000000030009', new row STO-000013 at top of Recent table with green 'Created in SAP' badge, detail modal shows green success banner with the real SAP Order ID + UUID; (4) FAILURE live path 014726-001 P4->P2: validate=done, check=FAILED (red), create stayed pending, red banner with verbatim SAP message 'The product 014726-001 in item 10 cannot be delivered from site . Check the sourcing-relevant master data.', row STO-000014 shows red 'Issue Found' badge, detail modal shows the same error verbatim in stock-transfer-detail-error and no success banner; (5) client-side validation blocks the dialog: no items -> 'Select at least one item.', past date -> 'Requested Delivery Date cannot be earlier than today.' - both shown in stock-transfer-form-error + toast, dialog did NOT open; (6) regression: product search/add, per-item warehouse picker (auto-fills ship-from), 'AI suggests source warehouse' hint, cascading ship-to site/location dropdowns, and AI Quick Entry parse->preview->Apply all render and work (LLM parsed 'transfer 2 of P27175 to P1 by tomorrow' correctly). No console errors. 2 real SAP writes were performed (1 real order 30009 created, 1 intentionally rejected).

ui_bugs.component: Confirm dialog success banner + detail modal
ui_bugs.issue: SAP Order ID is rendered raw with 35 leading zeros ('00000000000000000000000000000030009') instead of the human-readable '30009'. Same padded value shown in the success toast and in the detail modal's SAP Order ID line. Recommend stripping leading zeros for display.
For the SAP-rejected order STO-000014 the line item Status column still reads 'Available' (stock-check status), which reads confusingly next to the red 'SAP rejected this order' banner.

integration_issues.issue: The form is cleared (items, ship-to, location, date reset) immediately after the local save, i.e. before the SAP check result is known. When SAP rejects the order the user has lost all inputs and must re-enter the whole order to retry. Consider retaining the form until the job reports success.

issues: Ship-to Site validation ('same as Ship-from') is unreachable via the UI because the backend already excludes the ship-from site from the ship-to dropdown (P8 source -> only P1 offered) - the guard exists in runValidation() but cannot be triggered by a user; no defect, noted for coverage completeness.
The SAP error text renders with an empty site token and a double space ('delivered from site . Check...') - verbatim from SAP, but could be normalised before display.

action_items: Trim leading zeros from the SAP Order ID before displaying it in the success banner, toast and detail modal
Consider not resetting the form until the SAP job reports success, so a SAP rejection can be retried without re-entry
Optionally suppress/relabel the line-item 'Available' status in the detail modal when the order was rejected by SAP
critical_code_review_comments: StockTransferPage.js is ~800 lines - consider splitting the confirm/progress dialog and detail modal into their own components.

pollSapJob() swallows all axios errors and retries forever until the 3-minute wall clock; a persistent 404/500 on the status endpoint would show only the generic timeout message - consider surfacing repeated poll failures.
The 3-minute timeout branch sets phase 'failed' with a neutral 'still waiting' message rendered in the red error style, which could be mistaken for a real SAP rejection.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed (6/6), 3 cosmetic/UX issues found

seed_data_creation: Two real STOs created via the UI: STO-000013 (P27175, P8->P1, SUCCESS, real SAP order 30009) and STO-000014 (014726-001, P4->P2, intentional SAP rejection).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Warehouse dropdown option labels are 'P8 - RAW MATERIAL GODOWN-P8 (500)' format - do NOT match on 'P8-RM' (that short code only appears in the confirm dialog's items table). Ship-to dropdown excludes the ship-from site, so the same-site validation cannot be triggered from the UI. Live SAP combos with known outcome: P27175 P8->P1 = success (~8s), 014726-001 P4->P2 = SAP sourcing-master-data rejection at the 'check' step. Do not experiment with other product/site pairs - writes are irreversible against production SAP.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects. The padded SAP Order ID comes straight from SAP's ObjectID/ID field (35-char zero-padded) and is passed through to the UI without normalisation; the lost-form-state-on-failure issue is caused by confirmAndSubmit() clearing items/ship-to/date immediately after the POST succeeds locally, before the async SAP job resolves.
